stories.title: Campa Cola focuses on festive preparation
stories.summary: Campa Cola has unveiled a festive campaign, 'Tayyari Big, Tyohaar Bada Big,' conceptualised by McCann India. The brand aims to spotlight the cleaning, cooking and shopping that precede celebrations, positioning itself as a companion during the work. Festive advertising usually focuses on the final moment of celebration.

stories.title: Campa Cola turns festive preparations into the centrepiece of its new campaign
stories.summary: Campa Cola is shifting the spotlight from festive celebrations to the preparations that lead up to them with its latest campaign, ‘Tayyari Big, Tyohaar Bada Big’. Conceptualised by McCann India, part of Omnicom Advertising India, the campaign positions the beverage brand as part of the

stories.title: Hershey’s Kisses targets Diwali romance
stories.summary: Hershey’s India has launched a digital film for its 'Giving Kisses Is Hard' campaign, conceptualised by TBWA\Lintas. The narrative follows a couple attempting to find privacy during a family Diwali gathering. The campaign extends the brand's Valentine's Day communication into the festive season.

stories.title: YouTube Studio adds affiliate product suggestions
stories.summary: YouTube is rolling out a personalised product recommendation shelf in YouTube Studio, showing affiliate creators items to tag alongside estimated commission rates. The update also integrates creator support into the Ask Studio conversational assistant. Custom feeds are now replacing the topic chips that previously sat at the top.

stories.title: Meta denies knowingly running child exploitation ads
stories.summary: Meta stated it did not knowingly target ads featuring children after a BBC investigation found paid content promoting child abuse on Instagram. The company said ads are approved by moderation technology. Meta previously told the BBC that one such ad did not violate its community guidelines.

stories.title: HP India highlights local innovations
stories.summary: HP India has launched its 'Lights of Change' Diwali campaign, featuring six Indian innovations designed to address everyday challenges. The film showcases projects ranging from agricultural waste management to a self-learning Braille device for children. The initiative focuses on technology's impact across various communities.

stories.title: Amazon India uses childhood memories for Diwali
stories.summary: Amazon India's #DeliverTheLove campaign features a man sending an empty glass bottle to his siblings to recreate a childhood memory. The film uses the theme of family reunions to encourage presence during the festival. The company is positioning itself as a facilitator of emotional connections.

stories.title: Tata Starbucks positions stores as family spaces
stories.summary: Tata Starbucks is promoting its coffeehouses as settings for meaningful milestones in its 'Special Diwali ki Special Jagah' campaign. The film features a couple inviting family to their regular meeting spot to celebrate the festival. The chain is moving beyond product gifting to focus on relationships.

stories.title: South Indian Bank links Diwali to relationships
stories.summary: South Indian Bank has launched its 'Khushiyan Badhao, Diwali Manao' campaign, drawing on its brand philosophy of investing in relationships. The film features an open mic event where the protagonist questions what truly sparkles during the festival. It suggests the spirit of Diwali lies in togetherness.

stories.title: Lotte Pepero brings 11/11 tradition to India
stories.summary: Lotte India is introducing the Korean tradition of exchanging snack sticks on 11 November through an influencer-led digital campaign. The date was chosen because it resembles the shape of four Pepero sticks. The brand is inviting Indian consumers to celebrate friendship and sharing on this day.

stories.title: Swiggy adopts festive name for marketing
stories.summary: Swiggy has temporarily rebranded its Instagram display name to 'Sweety' for its Diwali marketing campaign. The platform also ran a front-page newspaper advertisement referencing a 1971 Bollywood song. The company is attempting to associate its delivery service with the festive season.

stories.title: Pernod Ricard moves media mandate to Initiative
stories.summary: Pernod Ricard has appointed Initiative as its media agency partner across nine markets in India and the Asia-Pacific region, effective 1 January 2027. The agency replaces Wavemaker, which held the account for over two decades. The mandate includes media planning, buying and consumer insights.

stories.title: Omnicom's Initiative wins Pernod Ricard media mandate
stories.summary: Pernod Ricard has appointed Initiative to manage its media mandate across nine markets in India and the Asia-Pacific region. The agency replaces Wavemaker, which held the account for over two decades in India and Singapore. The transition follows a competitive review of the company's media partners.

stories.title: Forrester finds growing homogeneity among top agencies
stories.summary: Forrester's latest Wave report on media management services assesses the 12 largest agency groups. The research firm concludes that industry consolidation has made these companies look more alike than ever. The biggest agencies are now effectively indistinguishable from one another.

stories.title: Prachi Narayan joins WPP Media
stories.summary: Prachi Narayan has been appointed head of partnerships at WPP Media's Media Futures Group. The agency solution was created exclusively for Google. Narayan, a former news anchor and content marketer, will lead partnerships at the bespoke global unit.

stories.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank names credit card marketing head
stories.summary: Richa Dholi has joined Kotak Mahindra Bank as head of marketing for credit cards. Dholi previously served as global marketing director at Qure.ai for nearly two years. Her career includes prior roles at HDFC Bank, Wunderman Thompson South Asia, Koo India, Ogilvy and Capgemini.

stories.title: X launches video clipping tool
stories.summary: X has introduced a tool allowing users to trim longer videos into shorter clips for posting. The company describes clipping as a pivotal technique for engagement. Every clip features a label that links back to the original video source.

stories.title: IAB releases creator economy research report
stories.summary: The IAB estimates creator media budgets will reach $44 billion this year. Its new report identifies seven opportunity areas to address industry challenges, noting that current systems for measuring, contracting and paying creators have not kept pace with the sector's rapid growth.

stories.title: Instagram tests long-form video incentives
stories.summary: Instagram is allowing videos up to 90 minutes and testing a program offering creators between $50,000 and $500,000 to post long-form content. The platform has not yet shared a concrete advertising model for these videos. Creators are currently trading discovery potential for uncertain income.

stories.title: IAB | The Creator Economy's Next Chapter
stories.summary: Creator marketing is already an established part of the media plan, with budgets more than tripling from $13.9 billion in 2021 to an expected $44 billion in 2026. Sustaining that investment, however, requires greater consistency in how creator work is measured, contracted, paid, and reported,

stories.title: EU draft law targets influencer transparency
stories.summary: The EU is considering the Digital Fairness Act, which would require influencers to label sponsored content as advertisements. The draft also proposes banning dark patterns and preventing brands from using influencers to encourage children to buy products. The proposal is expected to be unveiled Wednesday.

stories.title: EU plans tougher influencer advertising rules to protect children online
stories.summary: The measures are outlined in a draft Digital Fairness Act aimed at strengthening consumer protections online. EU Commissioner for Consumer Protection Michael McGrath is expected to unveil the proposal on Wednesday. The legislation seeks to close gaps in existing rules on data protection, artificial intelligence,

stories.title: EU Plans Crackdown On Influencer Marketing, Deceptive Online Practices
stories.summary: The European Union is planning stricter regulations on influencer marketing and deceptive online practices as part of efforts to strengthen consumer protection across the bloc. The proposed measures are contained in plans for a new law, the Digital Fairness Act, which is expected to be

stories.title: EU to crack down on influencer marketing
stories.summary: The EU already has multiple laws covering data protection, artificial intelligence and online content. stories.title: OpenAI introduces business agents for ChatGPT
stories.summary: OpenAI has launched a Business Hub allowing companies to verify profiles and publish branded chat agents in ChatGPT. The company is offering this as a way for brands to enter user conversations. OpenAI's vice president of monetization declined to share a timeline for further rollouts.

stories.title: X previews AI moderation explanation labels
stories.summary: X is testing AI-generated labels that explain why posts are flagged and provide an appeals process. The company's new head of safety argues that AI-led moderation creates better auditable records than human review. The platform previously labeled a SpaceX rocket launch as adult content.

stories.title: Priceline uses AI for Snapchat ads
stories.summary: Priceline is the first travel brand to deploy AI Sponsored Snaps on Snapchat. The feature allows advertisers to integrate their own chatbots directly into the platform. The company is using the technology to reach users during the holiday travel rush.

stories.title: Tokyo court dismisses Maezawa lawsuit against Meta
stories.summary: A Tokyo court dismissed billionaire Yusaku Maezawa’s lawsuit against Meta regarding fraudulent investment ads using his likeness. While the court acknowledged the ads infringed on his publicity rights, it ruled Meta is a platform operator not directly involved in the posts. The ads remain online.

stories.title: Tokyo Court Dismisses Suit against Meta over Fake Ads | Nippon.com
stories.summary: Tokyo, Nov. 10 (Jiji Press)--Tokyo District Court on Tuesday dismissed a lawsuit against U.S. social media giant Meta Platforms Inc. and its Japanese unit over fake ads that used a Japanese entrepreneur's name and likeness without permission. Presiding Judge Naoyuki Iwai dismissed both entrepreneur Yusaku

stories.title: Thailand consumer council sues Meta over scams
stories.summary: Thailand’s consumer protection body has sued Meta over fraudulent advertisements on Facebook and Instagram. The council recorded 3,793 complaints between 2024 and 2026, citing fake investment opportunities and undelivered goods. The lawsuit highlights ongoing concerns regarding the company’s responsibility to protect users from deceptive content.

stories.title: Meta users seek to revive scam ad lawsuit
stories.summary: Users are petitioning a federal appellate court to reinstate a lawsuit against Meta over pump-and-dump investment scams. Plaintiffs argue that Meta’s advertising tools generate the images and text used in the ads. The company maintains its systems are merely displaying advertiser-provided content.

stories.title: Alchemer launches AI conversational insights tool
stories.summary: Alchemer has introduced Alchemer Voice, an AI-powered platform designed to convert customer calls and support tickets into business intelligence. The company claims the solution helps teams uncover meaning and determine action, replacing hours of manual analysis with purpose-built AI and conversational analytics.

stories.title: Attentive announces AI-driven marketing vision
stories.summary: Attentive has unveiled a strategy for individualized marketing under new CEO Eric Miao. The platform now connects OpenAI and Anthropic tools to its data, aiming to create an always-on AI system that makes real-time decisions for brands across the entire customer lifecycle.

stories.title: Cision report examines AI and consumer trends
stories.summary: Cision’s latest report analyzes 564 million social media posts and thousands of search queries to explore consumer behavior. The study aims to help brands distinguish between passing trends and sustained interest by connecting insights from search, social media, and AI prompts.

stories.title: Apollo adds fraud prevention to sign-up process
stories.summary: Apollo has integrated IPQS email intelligence into its AI-driven go-to-market system. The company aims to prevent abusive sign-ups while maintaining access for legitimate users. Apollo stated that relying on a single provider was insufficient to achieve the depth of visibility required for its platform.

stories.title: Twilio report finds gap in AI service expectations
stories.summary: A Twilio survey reveals that 86 percent of companies believe their customers are satisfied with AI-powered service, while only 51 percent of consumers agree. The report highlights a disconnect between corporate metrics and the actual experience of customers regarding empathy and context.

stories.title: Stensul introduces self-improving email tool
stories.summary: Stensul has launched a self-improving email feature that links campaign performance to specific content. The company says each new send learns from the last to refine subject lines and preheaders. The tool is currently in early access for enterprise marketers.

stories.title: Writesonic launches AI brand monitoring agent
stories.summary: Writesonic has released features to track how AI models describe a brand and identify the sources used. Its new Outreach Agent contacts the websites cited by AI to request changes. The company says it helps marketers ensure AI-generated information is accurate.

stories.title: Inuvo expands CTV advertising intelligence
stories.summary: Inuvo has updated its IntentKey platform to provide neighborhood-level consumer interest data for connected television ads. The company says this allows advertisers to reach audiences without relying on personal identities or household profiles. The system uses dynamic AI models to evaluate localized interests.

stories.title: SpeedyIndex launches pay-per-check rank tracker
stories.summary: SpeedyIndex has released a Google rank tracker that operates on a token balance rather than a monthly subscription. The company notes that traditional competitors charge monthly fees for fixed keyword allowances. Checks are currently half price until December 2.

stories.title: Coframe raises $35 million for autonomous web design
stories.summary: Coframe has secured $35 million to build what it calls the living internet. The platform uses autonomous AI to continuously generate and test digital experiences for websites and ads. Investors include leaders from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind.

stories.title: Ogilvy launches talent-focused AI platform
stories.summary: Ogilvy has launched ECHO, an AI platform designed to scale creative content using verified talent scans. Developed with Creative Artists Agency, the system aims to protect intellectual property while generating localized assets from single shoots. The launch addresses industry concerns regarding unauthorized deepfakes.

research.title: A learner-free swarm approximates the explore-exploit equilibrium allocation: A self-organized attractor in place of reinforcement-learning
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) solves the explore-exploit problem by training a learner on reward, its multi-agent, resource-sharing form has an equilibrium allocation as its optimum -- the ideal-free distribution (IFD), the Nash equilibrium of a congestion game. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Can open citation data detect citation stacking? An audit against Clarivate's journal suppressions
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Clarivate suppresses journals from the Journal Citation Reports when self-citations or concentrated citations from another journal ("citation stacking") distort their Journal Impact Factor. Its data are closed. Yearly journal citation networks were built from the OpenCitations. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: CompAIssionate Other: Identity Assumptions in LLM Responses to Distress
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Individuals experiencing suicidal ideation (SI) or psychological distress may disclose their social identities when seeking support from LLMs. Attending to identity-related stressors can be important for providing contextually appropriate and empathetic support. However, disclosing an identity. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Computational Structure of Pairwise Housing Connectedness Networks
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Directed housing-submarket networks combine common market movement with heterogeneous bilateral relations, and different node-level measures need not yield distinct empirical rankings. We construct a positive pairwise net-connectedness network from the generalized forecast error variance decomposition (GFEVD). Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: ConnectionMind: Leveraging Social Networks and Large Language Models for Personalized Recommendation at Meta
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Modern recommendation systems on social media platforms such as Meta must model complex social relationships, including friendships, group memberships, and creator interactions, alongside massive and heterogeneous content such as text and video. Traditional recommendation models, however. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Continuous modeling of manipulative participation for stance analysis: Online discourse on the 2024 Street Animal Law in T\"urkiye
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Studies of online political discourse commonly infer public opinion through stance analysis while implicitly assuming that observed user participation is authentic. Meanwhile, studies focusing on detecting manipulative participation are typically modeling it as a binary phenomenon. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Counting Hypertriangles through Hypergraph Orientations
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Counting the number of small patterns is a central task in network analysis. While this problem is well studied for graphs, many real-world datasets are naturally modeled as hypergraphs, motivating the need for efficient hypergraph motif. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Do links to retracted papers predict future retractions? An out-of-sample test on the open biomedical citation graph
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Tools that screen manuscripts for research-integrity problems flag papers that cite retracted work, and retrospective studies report that such papers are retracted more often. This study tests the signal prospectively on open data. Predictors were computed. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
